summary_oneline: Delivery callbacks check notification_succeeded and return status 'failed'; manager isolates each callback, collects outcomes and stamps metadata.last_delivery_status + last_callbacks

claims.text: NotificationMixin.notification_succeeded is the existing predicate; send_* never raise
manager discards callback return values, aborts siblings on raise, ignores send_result status, stamps success before callbacks
outcomes can be persisted in metadata JSONB with the existing stamp pattern, no DDL

unknowns.question: persistence
unknowns.user_answer: separate keys: last_delivery_status + last_callbacks; last_status stays the agent-run status

recommended_next_command.rationale: high-confidence localization in 2 files, all design decisions resolved, ~2-3 tasks
